p0.title: The common ready/terminal/cycle machine does not execute the recursively frozen transcript
evidence: sink_ready tests ready_state bit0, while the frozen transcript is ready unless low three bits are 000
terminal_tail has no terminal state, block owner, committed-block bitmap, clear index/count/hash or terminal-owned directory-port semantics
production architecture traces are never compared to the six golden event hashes; synthetic cycle counts match 18/18/22/21 but event labels do not
shared links and ports are synchronously acquired and released without an explicit common priority scheduler, leaving multiple hazard/stall predicates structurally unreachable
p0.impact: Future A1/PBR4 totals are not on the frozen same-resource cycle coordinate.

p0.title: The functional reference shares candidate error domains and mandatory typed/protocol mismatches remain absent or literal zero
evidence: ReferenceAccumulator consumes the same event_taps descriptors and WeightSet.get address function as the candidate
descriptor identities omit the required typed numeric activity and independent source_sign_bit fields
source_time_output_cycle_mismatches is hard-coded to zero and there is no cross-architecture source/descriptor/frontier/commit/output conservation comparison
final output has no explicit owner/address/beat state from which duplicate, owner, address, stall-side-effect or cursor mismatches can be computed
p0.impact: Shared geometry/address, typed-source, output-protocol or terminal bugs can satisfy exact_gate and produce a false PASS.

p0.title: Mandatory traffic/conservation outputs and GO/support conjunctions are incomplete
evidence: per-row output omits source-scan bytes, group histogram, refill request/beat counts, persistent command/beat traffic, commit count, resident hit/miss and maximum occupancies
EXPECTED_REPLAY_BITS and EXPECTED_DENSE_DESTINATIONS are copied to result but never compared with executed counters
source-ledger equality, descriptor/commit conservation, capacity and hidden-state/port/bandwidth/oracle predicates are absent
GO and support-only use incomplete mismatch and traffic predicates
p0.impact: Ledger omissions or hidden state can be published as PASS_CPU_GO or PASS_CPU_SUPPORT_ONLY.

p1.title: N0-N9 identity bootstrap still has replaceable or weakly typed stages
evidence: the shell runner executes the analyzer without pre-exec SHA verification and relies on the analyzer to verify itself
verify_review accepts any authorization-bound 100/0/0 review without canonical per-stage schema/status/launch predicates
this failed M588 evidence is not the canonical future N2 PASS path and must not be renamed or copied into it

p1.title: Post-publication failures do not quarantine the canonical output
evidence: after os.replace(staging, output), failure_close ignores an existing canonical output
weights.close runs in finally; an exception after successful publication bypasses the preceding except and leaves result plus consumed attempt

p2.title: The builtin primary-class closure test is tautological and does not exercise production invariants
p2.evidence: For each name drawn from PRIMARY_CLASSES it checks name in terminal.classes or name in PRIMARY_CLASSES, whose second disjunct is always true.

decision.only_allowed_next_step: author a new immutable repaired analyzer/runner identity and request another fresh independent static hammer
